items.summary: Recommendation: continue the active reversible SEO and monetization work, while adding bounded evidence work for 0daynews.com, 0xroulette.com, complicated.work, and deadlymaracas.com. Known evidence: the 30-day SEO window reports 13,177 impressions, 126 clicks, 932 sessions, and 13 conversions across measured sites; Amazon reported $4.92 commission on 2026-09-21 from 6,219 clicks, 28 ordered items, and 6 shipped items. Site-level margin and ROI are not calculable because one tracking ID is unmapped and direct costs are unavailable. The main unknown is which additional sites can produce attributable revenue without disproportionate build or renewal cost. Smallest next step: complete the four bounded reports, preserve rollback notes, and measure existing implementations after 14 days or 100 new impressions. Owner question: for SearchWoot choose (A) prepare an unsent Woot permission request, (B) keep private with no outreach, or (C) stop pursuing public beta.
